summary: Backend-only iteration 4. Tested all 6 new admin management endpoints + regression. 25/25 pytest tests passed + an extra live probe confirming /admin/broadcast actually inserts notification docs visible via GET /api/notifications. GET /api/admin/users returns users with application_count + paid_count, no password_hash/_id leakage. GET /admin/users/{uid} returns {user, applications, payments, certificates} and 404 for missing IDs. PUT /admin/users/{uid} updates name/verified/city and returns sanitized user; correctly refuses self-demote-from-admin (HTTP 400). DELETE /admin/users/{uid} forbids self-delete (400), and for a freshly created throwaway phone-OTP user the delete returns {deleted:true} and a subsequent GET 404s. GET /admin/payments returns items + totals (count/paid_count/paid_paise/created_paise) with enriched applicant_name/event_title/user_email/user_phone; status_q=paid|created filters correctly. POST /admin/broadcast targets audiences and a live test of audience='all' sent N=20 with N matching active user count; the probe notification was visible in a freshly created participant's /api/notifications inbox. Auth-guard verified on all admin endpoints (non-admin JWT -> 403, no token -> 403). Light regression: admin login 200, phone OTP 123456 round-trip 200, GET /events returns >=1 item, POST /payments/create-order with real Razorpay test keys returns mock=false + order_id starting 'order_'. No 500s in backend logs during the run.

minor.issue: Returns 403 'Not authenticated' (FastAPI HTTPBearer default) instead of 401. Functionally fine but slightly inconsistent with REST norms — tests accept both.

audience='paid' uses applications.distinct('user_id', payment_status='paid') — if a user has multiple paid applications they still get only one notification (correct), but users with payments collection rows but no application doc would be missed (edge case).

action_items: Optional: standardize 'no token' on protected endpoints to return 401 rather than 403 (low priority; FastAPI HTTPBearer auto-403 default).
Optional: add a rate-limit / audit log for /admin/broadcast since a single call can write thousands of notifications.

Optional: in /admin/delete_user, also clean up entries in collections like certificates and payments (currently only applications + notifications + users are touched). Paid applications are correctly preserved with user_deleted=true.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:875-886 — /admin/users projection correctly excludes _id, password_hash and heavy media arrays. Stats counted with two count_documents per user (N+1 over users). Fine at <2000 users; if it grows, switch to a single aggregation $lookup.
server.py:908-921 — PUT /admin/users self-demote guard works only when role is being changed; if admin sends role='admin' it's a no-op (good). 'Nothing to update' returns 400 — sensible.

server.py:924-939 — DELETE soft-keeps paid applications via user_deleted flag; downstream queries should be aware (admin payments enrichment still works because it joins by id, not by user existence).
server.py:942-971 — /admin/payments enrichment uses dict-comprehension with `async for` inside dict braces; works on Python 3.11. Good batching (single find for apps + users).

success_rate.backend: 100% (25/25 admin + regression tests passed; plus an out-of-suite live broadcast/notification delivery probe also green)
success_rate.frontend: not tested this iteration (backend-only request per main agent)
